Who Oakbridge is for

High potential. High barriers. No reduced expectations.

Oakbridge is designed for justice-impacted and other aspiring entrepreneurs ready for structure, practical learning and accountable support.

We use identity-forward language because the barrier is the context — never the person. You arrive as a potential founder, operator and business owner.

Readiness, not perfection

What matters at the start.

You do not need polished branding, a perfect business plan or all the answers. You do need a willingness to work within a clear pathway.

01

An idea or capability

Something useful you can make, do, organise, solve or learn to deliver well.

02

Room for honest feedback

A willingness to test assumptions, hear from customers and change direction when the evidence asks for it.

03

Commitment to structure

Showing up, building routine and using support as part of the work — not as a sign of weakness.

A two-way commitment

What you can expect — and what Oakbridge asks of you.

From Oakbridge

  • Clear milestones and predictable learning
  • Practical business tools and systems
  • Mentoring that listens before it advises
  • Respectful accountability and continued support
  • An honest pathway if the business needs to pivot

From each participant

  • Participant-led goals you are willing to work towards
  • Regular attendance and honest communication
  • Respect for peers, mentors and shared space
  • A willingness to test, measure and learn
  • Ownership of decisions and the next milestone

From interest to first milestone

A clear beginning.

  1. 01

    Start the conversation

    Tell us what you want to build and what support would help you move.

  2. 02

    Explore readiness together

    Understand fit, goals, practical barriers and the structure the pathway requires.

  3. 03

    Agree the first milestone

    Begin with a realistic next action — then build evidence from there.
